user.description: Connection to the Proxon unit (Modbus TCP, e.g. via a serial gateway).

reconfigure.description: Update the Proxon unit's connection details.

zones_count.description: How many control panels/zones are installed? ZBP (main panel) always exists and is named separately in the next step.

zone_names.description: One room name per zone. NBP zones are asked for in order NBP1, NBP2, ... (Modbus register order, determines the mapping).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Please check address/port/slave id.
error.duplicate_zone_names: Two zones map to the same internal name (e.g. due to special characters) - please use unique room names.
